features: BRUSH + FINE DUAL TIP: Switch easily between detailed lines and expressive strokes with a 1 mm fine tip and a flexible 1–5 mm brush tip. These water-based acrylic paint markers are ideal for lettering, sketching, coloring, illustrations, and DIY art projects.

PREMIUM WATER-BASED ACRYLIC PAINT: Filled with richly pigmented, water-based acrylic paint, these markers deliver vibrant, opaque color on most surfaces. Coverage may vary depending on the surface color and material. The durable cotton nib provides smooth, consistent ink flow for reliable performance.

WORKS ON A VARIETY OF SURFACES: Create on paper, canvas, wood, rock, ceramic, glass, metal, and more. Results may vary by surface—non-porous materials such as glass, ceramic, and metal may require additional drying time for the best results.

PRE-ACTIVATED FOR EASY USE: Unlike traditional pump-action paint markers, these markers feature pre-activated cotton tips, so they're ready to use with no pressing required. For best performance, store horizontally, shake gently before first use, and test on scrap paper if needed.

GREAT FOR ARTISTS OF ALL SKILL LEVELS: Whether you're a beginner, hobbyist, or experienced artist, this acrylic paint marker set is perfect for creative projects, crafts, journaling, and DIY artwork. Conforms to ASTM D-4236 standards.
